Package index

Pseudo-bulk simulation

Aggregate single-cell profiles into phenotype-guided pseudo-bulk samples for deconvolution benchmarks.

aggregate_barcode_pseudo_bulk()
Aggregate pseudo-bulk samples by barcode (organoid)
aggregate_celltype_barcode_pseudo_bulk()
Aggregate pseudo-bulk samples by cell type and barcode
simulate_bootstrap_samples()
Simulate pseudo-bulk samples by cell resampling (bootstrap)
simulate_generative_models()
Simulate pseudo-bulk samples from generative count models

Gene annotation and filtering

Annotate mouse genes and filter unexpressed features before modelling.

annotate_genes_biomart()
Annotate mouse genes with Ensembl metadata
annotate_genes_local()
Annotate mouse genes using local Bioconductor databases
filter_deseq2_unexpressed_genes()
Filter pseudo-bulk genes for DESeq2 by cell type
filter_mast_unexpressed_genes()
Filter single-cell genes for MAST by cell type

Deconvolution and scoring

CIBERSORT helpers and composition metrics for estimated proportions.

cibersort()
Main functions
CoreAlg()
Core algorithm
eval_Aitchison()
Aitchison distance between two compositional vectors
eval_JSD()
Jensen-Shannon divergence between two compositional vectors
eval_MAE()
Mean absolute error for cellular proportion vectors
eval_MaxAE()
\(L_\infty\) absolute error between two compositions
eval_Pearson()
Pearson correlation between two compositional vectors
eval_RMSE()
Root mean squared error for cellular proportion vectors
eval_SDID()
Square-root sine distance between two compositional vectors
eval_TV()
Total variation (normalised MAE) between two compositions
eval_angular_distance()
Normalised angular distance between two compositions
eval_hrRMSE()
Hierarchical relative RMSE against a shared compositional reference
eval_presence_F1()
Presence F1 for spillover / missing cell types

Plotting and utilities

theme_features()
ggplot2 theme for benchmark and feature-selection figures
theme_features_pub()
Publication-sized variant of theme_features()
read_double_gz_rds()
Read a doubly gzip-compressed RDS file
